title: Simplex-vector noise stability
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\beta$ be finite nonempty sets, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f:\Omega^n\to\beta$. For $0\le\rho\le1$, define the simplex-vector noise stability as the expectation over a product-distributed input $x$ of the expected inner product of the simplex embeddings of $f(x)$ and $f(y)$, where $y$ is sampled from the product noise distribution at $x$ with parameter $\rho$.
